description: Source code for the RouteCompiler class in Drupal, which extends Symfony's RouteCompiler to add Drupal-specific route compilation logic, including path pattern normalization, path fitness calculation, and handling default placeholders.

classes.name: RouteCompiler
classes.description: A Drupal-specific route compiler extending Symfony's RouteCompiler, adding methods for path outline, path fitness, and handling default placeholders.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a Route object into a Drupal-specific CompiledRoute, adding path analysis and regex generation.

methods.name: getPatternOutline
methods.description: Returns a normalized path pattern with placeholders replaced by '%'.

methods.name: getFit
methods.description: Calculates a fitness score for a path based on fixed segments and wildcards.

methods.name: getPathWithoutDefaults
methods.description: Removes placeholders with default values from a route's path to aid in matching.
